description: This file defines the 'ProvisioningEntry' entity class, which represents a provisioning record related to accounting provisioning, including annotations for persistence (JPA) and Lombok for boilerplate code reduction. It manages provisioning entries, references to created/modified users, and timestamps.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntry
classes.description: Entity class representing a provisioning record, including provisioning entries, audit info, and metadata such as creation and modification info.

methods.name: setProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Adds a collection of provisioning entries to the current provisioningEntry set, initializing it if null.

methods.name: getLoanProductProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of associated LoanProductProvisioningEntry objects.
